_comment: Curated text fixes that survive DB re-exports. export_data.py applies each 'summaries' rule to the WHOLE card of any record whose episode_title/title/insight_title contains 'episode_title' (every string field except the title fields: summary, key_takeaway(s), investment_thesis, notable_quotes quote+speaker, Deep Dive overview/episode_evidence/falsification_tracks, ...) in podcast_summaries.json, archive.json and data.js (archive, mainContent, deepDives). 'drop_tickers' removes symbols from tickers_mentioned/key_tickers of matched records. 'global_replacements' are exact swaps applied to every non-title string everywhere (incl. pundits, overton speakers, podcastGuests). 'terms' rules overwrite fields of suggestedTerms entries whose term matches exactly. Replacements are exact substring swaps; once the DB text is fixed they become no-ops. Oct 2026: 'bet' wording swaps (Jared's rule: nothing on the public site is called a bet) live in global_replacements; site_text_sanitize style gate warns on any new ones.

replacements: He also predicts current H100-class hardware could be obsolete within about 20 years.

He is still long Nvidia and chip stocks, on the view that cheaper compute raises total demand.
